load_coco_annotations: load a COCO annotation JSON file into memory and create an index for fast lookup
get_ann_ids: get annotation IDs filtered by image IDs, category IDs, area range, or crowd label
decode_mask: decode a binary mask encoded via run-length encoding into a 2D boolean numpy array
encode_mask: encode a 2D boolean numpy array into run-length encoding format for compact storage
seg_to_mask: convert polygon segmentation coordinates into a binary mask of specified height and width
